facts.fact: Seneweb reports that Law No. 2025-15 of 4 September 2025 guaranteeing the right of access to information was promulgated, recognises the right of any person to information held by public bodies, and sets a response time of eight days extendable to fifteen.
facts.system: Law No. 2025-15 on the right of access to information

facts.fact: Seneweb reports that the Commission nationale d'accès à l'information (CONAI) provided for by the law was still not installed on 28 September 2026, and that articles 11 and 12 duties (monitoring committee, officer training, official request form) did not yet appear to be applied.
